name: codex-local-bridge
description: Private OAuth MCP bridge with revocable project grants, safe automatic code writes and sandboxed Codex tasks.

interface.longDescription: Delegate and continue Codex tasks, inspect real tests and diffs, and read project files. Locally granted projects permit automatic ordinary code writes; risky actions require separate approval. Requires local installation, ChatGPT Codex login and OAuth HTTPS connection.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Codex Local Bridge to plan a task, delegate it to my authorized local project, review the returned diff and tests, and continue the same Codex thread.
